card.name: Words before charged or hostile terms
card.fires_on: Small words and partial words just before a harsh, hostile or scandal-related term, such as a superlative before 'hypocrites' or 'a' before 'verse'. The marked word is usually a filler, not the charged word itself.

modes.label: Linking word before insult
modes.description: A small word or adjective sits just before a condemning or accusing noun.
modes.example: called Henry III "one of the<< greatest>> hypocrites who ever lived"

modes.label: Partway through a word
modes.description: A broken-off piece of a word or symbol appears where a negative word is about to be completed.
modes.example: an immense majority of the people are invincibly<< a>>verse from a conflict

modes.label: Before a violent or conflict term
modes.description: A word comes right before a war, violence or scandal term.
modes.example: Midnight Rising: John Brown & the Raid that Sparked<< the>> Civil War

card.writes: It nudges the output toward words about terror, sabotage, offensives and devils, and away from unrelated word pieces.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a harsh, hostile or violent word is expected.
